853:t_98:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, as an extra prize, I shall give you a slightly naughty photo book.」

853:t_98:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I saw that coming, so I put extra weights on my feet today to keep myself from floating.」

853:t_98:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, please enjoy it to your heart's content.」

853:t_98:10.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Th-this is bad...! If $$ミコノ$$ sees me like this...!」

853:t_98:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You need more training if a bluff like that rattles you enough to make you float.」

853:t_98:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Therefore, I am confiscating this photo book.」

853:t_99:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You are openly on your guard. Have you foreseen something?」

853:t_99:6.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I don't need to. Your very existence is already an ill omen.」

853:t_99:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I only wanted to congratulate you, $$カイエン$$, and this is how you treat me...」

853:t_99:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whatever you may say, you can't leave someone in trouble alone. That big-brother instinct is your best quality, $$カイエン$$.」

853:t_99:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, just for today, may I call you Big Bro?」

853:t_99:13.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I knew I couldn't let my guard down around you!」

853:t_100:4.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Th-thank you, $$ＡＧ$$... But don't come any closer.」

853:t_100:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aww, whyyy? I only want to congratulate you, $$ミコノ$$!」

853:t_100:6.en:
$$ミコノ$$
(I-I'm scared... But I can't keep cowering forever...!)

853:t_100:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Cut it out, $$ＡＧ$$! If you try anything else dirty, I'll get angry too!」

853:t_100:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mwah! A pretty girl's anger is the best! Thank you for the treat!」

853:t_101:4.en:
$$アンディ$$
「After all these years of digging holes and hardship, I finally feel like I've made it out of a long tunnel!」

853:t_101:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What hardship are you talking about...? You and $$ＭＩＸ$$ are getting along so well. Please put up with a little trouble.」

853:t_101:6.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Yeah! For $$ＭＩＸ$$, I'll endure anything, no matter how painful!」

853:t_101:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please give $$ＭＩＸ$$ to me. I promise to make her happy.」

853:t_101:8.en:
$$アンディ$$
「How could I do that?!」

853:t_101:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying? You just said you could endure anything for $$ＭＩＸ$$, didn't you, $$アンディ$$?」

853:t_101:10.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Uh... ah... I-I did say that, but...」

853:t_101:11.en:
$$アンディ$$
「I give up $$ＭＩＸ$$ for $$ＭＩＸ$$'s sake... But that's... No... if it's for $$ＭＩＸ$$'s sake, then I endure...」

853:t_101:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... You've fallen into my hole. My plan is a success.」

853:t_102:4.en:
$$モロイ$$
「I can do this much if I try. Believe it or not, I'm known at $$聖天使学園$$ as a guy with hidden talent.」

853:t_102:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It is good that you didn't end up as a secret weapon that stayed a secret.」

853:t_102:6.en:
$$モロイ$$
「What are you saying, $$ＡＧ$$?! Once people recognize my abilities, I can shine like this!」

853:t_102:7.en:
$$モロイ$$
「In other words, it is wrong not to use me, and the brass are to blame for burying my talent. Only structural reform can change this situation.」

853:t_102:8.en:
$$モロイ$$
「To that end, I will lead the reform...」

853:t_102:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I had forgotten... that $$モロイ$$ is also a hot-blooded man from the tropics...)

853:t_103:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Oh, it's you, $$ＡＧ$$. You still have that strange smell about you.」

853:t_103:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You may talk about $$シルフィ$$ and all that, $$カグラ$$, but the one your instincts crave is me.」

853:t_103:8.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Y-you're lying...! Don't spout that bullshit!!」

853:t_103:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now... Across 12,000 years, let us love each other as our instincts dictate.」

853:t_104:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand, $$ジン$$. You would rather have a congratulatory kiss from $$ユノハ$$ than congratulations from a robot like me.」

853:t_104:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your honesty is commendable. However, a man needs to take the lead precisely because it is the first time.」

853:t_104:8.en:
$$ジン$$
「Even if you tell me that, I...」

853:t_104:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It will be fine! I, $$ＡＧ$$, will teach you, so let's practice right here.」

853:t_104:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! First, let us start with the most basic step: judging the distance to your partner with your eyes closed.」

853:t_104:12.en:
$$ジン$$
「Is this how I do it...?」

853:t_104:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(He really is so trusting. If $$ユノハ$$ saw him trying to kiss me, she would not just turn invisible; she would vanish instantly...)

853:t_105:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait a moment! The congratulatory ceremony isn't over yet!」

853:t_105:6.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「After all, you're planning some sort of sexual harassment under the pretext of celebrating, aren't you?」

853:t_105:8.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I knew it! I'll punish your indecency with my fists!」

853:t_105:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you! This is what I was waiting for!」

853:t_105:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh, your impact force is the best, $$ゼシカ$$!」

853:t_105:11.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「N-noooo! Your idea of sexual harassment is getting even broader!!」

853:t_106:4.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. And thank you for all your hard work.」

853:t_106:6.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Thanks to $$アンディ$$... I've come to understand men a little better.」

853:t_106:7.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Men seek women to soothe their hearts, worn out from day after day of fighting... You're tired too, aren't you, $$ＡＧ$$?」

853:t_106:9.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Come here. If you don't mind it being me, I'll soothe you, $$ＡＧ$$.」
